## Line clipping

`clip_line_at_intersection` (in `line_geometry.hpp`) clips a polyline at the first segment-segment crossing with a reference polyline. When the crossing lies between existing vertices, a new point is inserted at the intersection so `KeepDistal` uses that location as the new base and `KeepBase` uses it as the new distal end.
